description: This PHP source file defines the Task controller for the Opencart admin marketplace module. It manages listing, starting, pausing, clearing, deleting, and logging of marketplace-related tasks, interacting with task models, handling permissions, and rendering views.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Controller class for handling marketplace tasks within the Opencart admin panel, including task listing, execution, status management, and logging.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets up breadcrumbs, and renders the main marketplace task view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the task list view output.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and compiles a list of tasks based on filters and pagination.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the start of the background task execution process.

methods.name: cli
methods.description: Executes tasks via command line, processing pending tasks in a loop.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses all pending tasks by setting their status to 'paused'.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected tasks by their IDs.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Updates the status of selected tasks to a specified state.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Returns the task log view output.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Fetches logs with pagination for display in the admin interface.
